title: Add multi-language i18n support to CLI output
description: Add multi-language support to the CLI's user-facing output strings (currently hard-coded English) by introducing a message-catalog lookup keyed by locale, selected via a --locale flag or LANG environment variable, with English as the fallback for missing keys.
acceptanceCriteria: All currently hard-coded user-facing strings are routed through the message-catalog lookup.
Passing --locale=<supported-locale> produces output in that locale for at least two non-English locales.
A missing translation key falls back to the English string rather than printing a raw key or throwing.
An unsupported --locale value falls back to English and does not crash the CLI.
verificationMethod: test-suite: run CLI output snapshot tests for each supported locale plus fallback-behavior tests for missing keys and unsupported locales.
groundTruth: A locale-keyed dictionary maps message keys to translated strings; a lookup helper resolves the active locale's entry, falling back first to the key's English entry and only then to the raw key if the message system itself is misconfigured.
